c1-17-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careful Statement
c1-17-01.scenario: You and a friend read a news report about talks between two states. A final declaration is being drafted.
c1-17-01.prompt: Say carefully that the talks would be good for both sides, and that a harsh proposal would hardly be acceptable.
cues: Say carefully what the talks would bring
Say the proposal would hardly be acceptable
c1-17-01.target: Úgy vélhetnénk, hogy a tárgyalás mindkét félnek előnyös volna. Ez a javaslat aligha volna elfogadható.
c1-17-01.english: One might think the talks would be advantageous to both sides. This proposal would hardly be acceptable.
c1-17-01.canDo: I can word a careful diplomatic statement (*Úgy vélhetnénk, hogy …*, *Hajlunk arra a megállapításra, hogy …*, *aligha volna elfogadható*).

c1-17-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Tension Arises
c1-17-02.scenario: You and a friend look at a map in a book about Central Europe. The book shows the border of two great powers.
c1-17-02.prompt: Say where tension arises, and say which way the border runs along the river.
cues: Say which way the border runs
c1-17-02.target: Ott, ahol két nagyhatalom befolyási övezete találkozik, gyakran feszültség keletkezik. Amerre a folyó folyik, arra húzódik a határ.
c1-17-02.english: There, where two great powers' spheres of influence meet, tension often arises. In the direction the river flows, the border runs that way.
c1-17-02.canDo: I can pair a place or direction with its answer (*Ott, ahol …*, *Amerre …, arra …*, *Ahonnan …, onnan …*).

c1-17-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Alliance's Commitments
c1-17-03.scenario: You and a friend read a text about an alliance and its member states.
c1-17-03.prompt: Say that strengthening the defence capability is a task for the member states, and that fulfilling the obligations is everyone's responsibility.
cues: Say whose responsibility the obligations are
c1-17-03.target: A tagállamok védelmi képességének megerősítése fontos feladat. A szövetségi kötelezettségek teljesítése minden tagállam felelőssége.
c1-17-03.english: Strengthening the member states' defence capability is an important task. Fulfilling the alliance obligations is the responsibility of every member state.
c1-17-03.canDo: I can chain two or three nouns in treaty language (*a tagállamok védelmi képességének megerősítése*).

c1-17-04.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Crisis Began
c1-17-04.scenario: You and a friend read about a diplomatic crisis. Talks were planned, but fighting broke out.
c1-17-04.prompt: Say that the fighting began before the talks could even start, and that the observers began work as soon as the ceasefire took effect.
cues: Say what happened before the talks
Say what happened when the ceasefire took effect
c1-17-04.target: Mielőtt még a tárgyalások elkezdődtek volna, elkezdődött a harc. Mihelyt a tűzszünet életbe lépett, a megfigyelők megkezdték a munkát.
c1-17-04.english: Before the talks had even started, the fighting began. As soon as the ceasefire took effect, the observers began their work.
c1-17-04.canDo: I can say that one event came before another could even happen (*Mielőtt még … volna, …*).

c1-17-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Szűcs and the West
c1-17-05.scenario: You and a friend talk about Szűcs Jenő's essay on the three historical regions of Europe.
c1-17-05.prompt: Say that Central Europe's towns grew stronger just as in the West, and that Szűcs did not count the region as part of the East.
cues: Compare Central Europe with the West
Say where Szűcs places the region
c1-17-05.target: Miként Nyugaton, akként Közép-Európában is megerősödtek a városok. Szűcs szerint a térség nem a Kelet része.
c1-17-05.english: Just as in the West, so in Central Europe too the towns grew stronger. According to Szűcs, the region is not part of the East.
c1-17-05.canDo: I can compare two situations with *miként … akként …* (*Miként Nyugaton, akként Közép-Európában is …*).

c1-17-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Talking About the Region
c1-17-consolidation.scenario: You and a friend talk about what you read in this unit about diplomacy, alliances and Szűcs Jenő's essay.
c1-17-consolidation.prompt: Say carefully that talks would help, and say how the West and Central Europe are alike in Szűcs's essay.
cues: Say carefully that talks would help
Compare the West and Central Europe
c1-17-consolidation.target: Úgy vélhetnénk, hogy a tárgyalás mindkét félnek előnyös volna. Miként Nyugaton, akként Közép-Európában is megerősödtek a városok.
c1-17-consolidation.english: One might think the talks would be advantageous to both sides. Just as in the West, so in Central Europe too the towns grew stronger.
c1-17-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about diplomacy, borders and alliances in Hungarian.
